Score a candidate detector against generated test cases

evaluate_detector.Rd

Runs the (LLM-produced) detector over the positives and freshly generated negatives and returns the same recall/precision report used to build the package's own fixtures — so you can see how well the suggested function works before adopting it.

Usage

evaluate_detector(detector, examples, type_name = "candidate", seed = 514)

Arguments

detector

A function taking a character vector and returning a logical vector (the function the LLM wrote).

examples

The same positive examples passed to [draft_detector_prompt()].

type_name

Optional label for the report header.

seed

Integer seed (match the drafting call for identical negatives).

Value

The results table from [formex::build_autotype_results()], invisibly, after printing the error report via [formex::generate_autotype_report()].

See also

[draft_detector_prompt()]
